case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 831 OF 2023; SLP(C) NO. 19492 OF 2021; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 832 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 833 OF 2023

parties.petitioner: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Union of India and State of Maharashtra

summary: Challenge to Consumer Protection Rules, 2020; validity of Rule 3(2)(b) (20 years experience requirement), Rule 4(2)(c) (15 years experience requirement), and Rule 6(9) (selection committee procedure) examined; rules struck down by Bombay High Court as arbitrary under Article 14; constitutional validity of experience thresholds and discretionary selection process at issue; no written examination requirement challenged as undermining judicial competence; prior 2017 model rules referenced with written exam provision; Consumer Protection Act, 2019 statutory framework considered; appeal by Union and State against High Court's invalidation.
legal_provisions_cited: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 s.29, s.43, s.101(2)(n), s.101(2)(w)
